language_security.bounded_enum_runtime: Frozen {enum,name} symbols. Numeric/XML/name/member/iteration facts use exported enumValue, enumFromValue, enumXml, enumFromXml, enumString and enumMembers. Proposed direct EnumType/member methods are not SDK exports; matching batch routes alone do not close public protocols.
language_security.bounded_style_owner: Synchronous live views admitted by always-async openDocumentStyleModel; general Document/Paragraph/Run/Table bindings remain absent. CLI potential-creating model getter uses explicit dry-run.
language_security.bounded_image_runtime: Always-async from_blob/from_file; dedicated ImageModelInput/ImageModelContext; synchronous immutable metadata and Length sizing; no raw host path or implicit fetch authority.
language_security.units: Checked safe-integer EMUs and half-away rounding; explicit factory/Length values instead of native numeric subclass/coercion.
language_security.security: Original memfs/owned bytes only for new regression; portable bundle in memory; no product/native runtime, implicit networking, host clock or host filesystem authority introduced.
